newsitem.title: USA: Bed Bath Jan same-store sales up 9.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bed Bath Jan same-store sales up 9.5 pct.

text.p: Bed Bath & Beyond Inc Thursday said net sales for the four weeks ended January 26 rose 36.0 percent to about $62.3 million from about $45.8 million a year ago, while same-store sales rose about 9.5 percent.
Bed Bath & Beyond is a nationwide chain of superstores selling better quality domestics merchandise and home furnishings. The company currently operates 108 stores in 25 states.
In fiscal 1997, it intends to open approximately 30 new superstores.
